## Problem / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe clearly (e.g. "I have friction when working with multi-root workspaces...").

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision the CLI / API behavior.

## Alternative Solutions Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Impact & Value
How will this feature benefit developers and AI coding workflows?

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or schema examples here.
